https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/.release_text: Release information This card was included in the Guardians Rising expansion with artwork by You Iribi , first released in the Japanese Islands Await You expansion. It was later included as a Mirror Holofoil print in the Japanese Facing a New Trial subset. It was reprinted as one of the Japanese SM-P Promotional cards with new artwork by kirisAki , made available in the Alolan Vulpix Special Set from April 21, 2017, which could be purchased at Pokémon Centers, Pokémon Stores, and other participating store chains, including: 7-Eleven , Circle K Sunkus , Daily Yamazaki , FamilyMart , Ministop , and Lawson . This print later became an English Yellow A Alternate card , available in the Ultra Prism Three Pack Blisters released February 2, 2018. Another Japanese SM-P Promotional version of this print with a different collection number was 1 of 5 cards available in special packs of Daiichi Choco & Custard Pan and Daiichi Bacon & Potato Pan from December 1, 2018. This version has the Daiichi Pan Pokémon Pan logo on the bottom right corner of the artwork. Two versions of the Guardians Rising print were included in the Sun & Moon Trainer Kit: Alolan Sandslash & Alolan Ninetales . Both feature a blue circle at the bottom right of the card, one with a 14 inside it and the other with a 29. These numbers indicated the cards' position in the deck for a practice duel. Variants of the Guardians Rising print were available again as part of the French McDonald's Collection 2018 , both as Non Holofoil and Reverse Confetti Holofoil cards. The Guardians Rising print was reprinted in the Japanese GX Ultra Shiny subset. A new print with artwork by Kouki Saitou featuring the Shiny version of Alolan Vulpix was included in the Hidden Fates expansion, which was also included in the GX Ultra Shiny subset. A Cosmos Holofoil version of the Guardians Rising print was given away at Toys "R" Us stores in 2017 to celebrate the expansion's release. It features the store logo in the bottom left corner of the artwork.

Release information This card was released as a Cosmos Holofoil SVP Black Star Promo and was available in the Scarlet & Violet Three Pack Blisters from March 31, 2023. In Japan, it was one of eight SV-P Promotional cards available in Let's Start Playing Pokémon Card Game Campaign Promo Card Packs, which were given to customers who purchased at least 10 packs of Scarlet ex or Violet ex at select retailers starting January 20, 2023. [ 1 ] It was also one of the four possible cards available in ex Starter Set Fuecoco & Ampharos ex Promo Card Packs. The Japanese print is Mirror Holofoil. Initial prints of this card used Smooth Cosmos Holofoil paper. Prints available in subsequent production runs of the Scarlet & Violet Three Pack Blisters, released in mid-2024, used the Pixel Cosmos Holofoil paper that was reintroduced in the first year of the Scarlet & Violet Series.

Release information This card was one of three promotional cards released in conjunction with the Pokémon Trading Card Game Illustration Contest 2022 . [ 1 ] It was available in a sealed pack with other SWSH Black Star Promos Bulbasaur and Greninja in the United States , Canada , and the United Kingdom . People wishing to receive a pack were required to submit their details on a dedicated registration website; valid applicants received a one-time use code via email that could be redeemed with an eligible purchase on region-specific Pokémon Center online stores. [ 2 ] The registration website opened on December 19, 2022 at 12:00 PM ET and was open to residents of the United States, Canada (except Quebec), and the United Kingdom; it closed on January 12, 2023 at 11:59 PM ET. [ 3 ] Codes were distributed in waves to eligible entrants within 16 weeks of entry, which could then be used in conjunction with any purchase worth at least $30 USD (before taxes), $30 CAD (excluding GST), or £30 GBP (inclusive of VAT) from region-specific Pokémon Center online stores. [ 2 ] Codes were valid until September 30, 2023 at 11:59 PM ET. [ 2 ] In Japan, the three cards were released as a S-P Promotional cards and were similarly distributed together in a sealed pack. Starting December 16, 2022, packs were given to customers who purchased at least ¥2000 worth of eligible products at participating Pokémon Centers and Pokémon Stores, as well as the Pokémon Center Online. The promotion ran for as long as stocks lasted. [ 4 ] The artwork on this card is by REND, selected as the Grand Prize winner in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Illustration Contest 2022. The contest logo is present above the Pokédex entry on all prints.

Release information This card was one of the XY Black Star Promos available in the BREAK Evolution Box Featuring Arcanine , released January 6, 2017. A Jumbo print was also included in the Box. In Japan, this card was included in the October 2016 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban! released on August 20, 2016. The CoroCoro Ichiban! logo is featured in the bottom left corner of the Japanese card.

Release information This card was included in the English Fates Collide expansion, first released in the Japanese Awakening Psychic King expansion with artwork by kirisAki . It was reprinted with new artwork by the same artist as one of the XY Black Star Promos available in the Evolutions Three Pack Blisters , released alongside the Evolutions expansion. In Japan, this print was one of the XY-P Promotional cards , and was 1 of 12 cards available in special promotional packs awarded to participants of Pokémon Card Gym tournaments across Japan from May 2016 through to July 2016. This print features the Pokémon Card Gym logo.

Release information In Japan, this card was included as a Regular card, a Full Art card , a Special Full Art card, and as a Secret Rainbow Rare in the Remix Bout subset. The Regular print features artwork by Mitsuhiro Arita , the Full Art and Rainbow Rare prints feature artwork by 5ban Graphics , while the Special Full Art print features artwork by Kagemaru Himeno . The Regular, Full Art, and Rainbow Rare prints were included in the Cosmic Eclipse expansion, while the Special Full Art print became a SM Black Star Promo available in the TAG TEAM Generations Premium Collection . A Jumbo version of the Special Full Art print was also included in the collection.

Release information This card was available in the English Kalos Power Tins , released on June 12, 2014. In Japan, it was released as one of the XY-P Promotional cards and was given to those who participated in the Lizardon Mega Battle, held at the Pacifico Yokohama, Yokohama on the weekend of May 3-4, 2014, and at Intex Osaka, Osaka on the weekend of May 17-18, 2014.

Release information This card was included in the Chaos Rising expansion, first released in the Japanese Ninja Spinner expansion, with artwork by Gemi . Holofoil versions with the Chaos Rising logo in the bottom right corner of the artwork were given away with eligible Pokémon Trading Card Game purchases of $15 or more at participating retailers in various countries, to commemorate the launch of the Chaos Rising expansion on May 22, 2026. Participating retailers include Best Buy in the United States , Mr Toys and Toymate in Australia , and JB Hi-Fi in New Zealand . [ 1 ] In Taiwan and Hong Kong , this card is reprinted as a Traditional Chinese M-P Promotional card with new artwork by Souichirou Gunjima , and is released as a random reward from a promo card pack included in the "Ninja Spinner Value Set" booster box, released on March 27, 2026. [ 2 ] The Traditional Chinese M-P Promotional print is released internationally as an MEP Black Star Promotional card and was one of the Prerelease promos for Chaos Rising , available in the Chaos Rising Build & Battle Box . A print with a gold foil "Staff" stamp was given to those overseeing Prerelease Tournaments . The Chaos Rising print was also included as a Non-Holofoil card in the Chaos Rising Build & Battle Box.

Release information This card was first released as one of the English XY Black Star Promos on October 12, 2013 in the Fennekin Box with artwork by 5ban Graphics . It was later released in the English Kalos Starter Set , originating from the Japanese XY Beginning Set , with different artwork also by 5ban Graphics . The XY Promotional print was later released as one of three Japanese XY-P Promotional cards randomly included in the Lizardon Mega Battle Mega Pack , released on April 19, 2014. The Kalos Starter Set print was later reprinted as an exclusive Confetti Holofoil in the English McDonald's Collection 2014 . A version of the XY-P print with the Daiichi Pan Pokémon Pan logo in the bottom right corner of the artwork was one of five cards included in special packs of Daiichi Choco Pan and Daiichi Ham Mayonnaise Pan available from January 1, 2015. During the Sword & Shield Series, the Kalos Starter Set print was reprinted in the McDonald's Collection 2021 as both a Non Holo and a Confetti Holo. A Jumbo version of the XY Promotional print was one of three cards available in copies of the Kalos First Partner Pack , released on May 7, 2021. Both of these cards were released to commemorate the 25th Anniversary of the Pokémon franchise and feature a foil Pokémon 25th Anniversary logo in the bottom right corner of the illustration window.

Release information This card was first released as one of the English XY Black Star Promos on October 12, 2013 in the Fennekin Box with artwork by 5ban Graphics . It was later released in the English Kalos Starter Set , originating from the Japanese XY Beginning Set , with different artwork also by 5ban Graphics . The XY Promotional print was later released as one of three Japanese XY-P Promotional cards randomly included in the Lizardon Mega Battle Mega Pack , released on April 19, 2014. The Kalos Starter Set print was later reprinted as an exclusive Confetti Holofoil in the English McDonald's Collection 2014 . A version of the XY-P print with the Daiichi Pan Pokémon Pan logo in the bottom right corner of the artwork was one of five cards included in special packs of Daiichi Choco Pan and Daiichi Ham Mayonnaise Pan available from January 1, 2015. During the Sword & Shield Series, the Kalos Starter Set print was reprinted in the McDonald's Collection 2021 as both a Non Holo and a Confetti Holo. A Jumbo version of the XY Promotional print was one of three cards available in copies of the Kalos First Partner Pack , released on May 7, 2021. Both of these cards were released to commemorate the 25th Anniversary of the Pokémon franchise and feature a foil Pokémon 25th Anniversary logo in the bottom right corner of the illustration window.

Release information This card was included in the Scarlet & Violet expansion with artwork by Tika Matsuno , first released in the Japanese Violet ex expansion. It was reprinted as a Cosmos Holofoil SVP Black Star Promo with different artwork by Uta and was available in the Paldea Evolved Single Pack Blisters from June 9, 2023. Due to a change in the Holofoil paper used by the manufacturer, this print was available in both Smooth and Pixel Cosmos Holofoil. In Japan, this print was one of seven SV-P Promotional cards available in Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack 1 , which was distributed at Pokémon Card Gym venues starting January 20, 2023. [ 1 ] The Japanese version of this print is Non Holofoil and features the Pokémon Card Gym logo.

Release information This card was included as a Regular card and a Full Art illustration rare card in the 30th Celebration special expansion. The Regular print features artwork by Megumi Mizutani , while the Full Art illustration rare print features artwork by 0313 .

Release information This card was included as a Regular card and a Full Art illustration rare card in the 30th Celebration special expansion. The Regular print features artwork by Megumi Mizutani , while the Full Art illustration rare print features artwork by 0313 .

Release information This card was included as both a Regular card and a Full Art Secret card in the Battle Styles expansion, first released in the Japanese Single Strike Master expansion. The Regular print features artwork by Ryota Murayama , while the Secret print features artwork by PLANETA Mochizuki . A SWSH Black Star Promotional print of this card was one of the Prerelease promos for Battle Styles with different artwork by Uta , available in the Battle Styles Build & Battle Box . This print was subsequently released in the Japanese Gengar VMAX High-Class Deck . The Battle Styles Regular print was reprinted, alongside a Full Art Secret card with artwork by NC Empire featuring Grimsley, in the Japanese VMAX Climax subset. The Battle Styles Regular print was reprinted again in the Japanese Start Deck 100 as a Non Holofoil card. The VMAX Climax Full Art Secret print was later included in the Brilliant Stars expansion.

Release information This card was included as both a Regular card and a Full Art Secret card in the Battle Styles expansion, first released in the Japanese Single Strike Master expansion. The Regular print features artwork by Ryota Murayama , while the Secret print features artwork by PLANETA Mochizuki . A SWSH Black Star Promotional print of this card was one of the Prerelease promos for Battle Styles with different artwork by Uta , available in the Battle Styles Build & Battle Box . This print was subsequently released in the Japanese Gengar VMAX High-Class Deck . The Battle Styles Regular print was reprinted, alongside a Full Art Secret card with artwork by NC Empire featuring Grimsley, in the Japanese VMAX Climax subset. The Battle Styles Regular print was reprinted again in the Japanese Start Deck 100 as a Non Holofoil card. The VMAX Climax Full Art Secret print was later included in the Brilliant Stars expansion.

Release information This card was released as a Cosmos Holofoil SVP Black Star Promo and was available in the Obsidian Flames Three Pack Blisters from August 11, 2023. In Japan, it was one of seven SV-P Promotional cards available in Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack 1 , which was distributed at Pokémon Card Gym venues starting January 20, 2023. [ 1 ] The Japanese print has the Pokémon Card Gym logo in the bottom right corner of the artwork.

Release information In Japan, this card was first released in the Cobalion Battle Strength Deck . It was released in English on September 19, 2012 in the Emerging Challenges Box as a Mirror Reverse Holofoil BW Black Star Promo.

Release information This card was included in the 30th Celebration special expansion with artwork by Hideki Ishikawa . An MEP Black Star Promotional print with artwork by Taiga Kasai is included in the 30th Celebration Tech Sticker Collection from September 16, 2026. In Japan, the promotional print was released as a M-P Promo card in the 30th CELEBRATION Promo Card Pack.

Release information This Holofoil card was included in the Plasma Blast Three Pack Blisters released August 14, 2013. In Japan, it was one of five Non Holofoil cards included in special packs of Daiichi Melon Pan and Daiichi Curry Pan released starting February 2013.

Release information This card was included in the Brilliant Stars expansion with artwork by GIDORA , first released in the Japanese Star Birth expansion. A SWSH Black Star Promotional print of this card was one of the Prerelease promos for Brilliant Stars with new artwork by NC Empire , available in the Brilliant Stars Build & Battle Box . A print with a gold foil "Staff" stamp was later retroactively distributed to Pokémon Leagues in early 2023. The SWSH Promotional print was subsequently released in the Japanese VSTAR Universe subset.

Release information In Japan, this card was one of three random XY-P Promotional cards packaged with any one order of special Uniqlo Pokémon Card Game T-shirts from participating Uniqlo stores. The promotion began in late February 2016 in commemoration of the release of the BREAK Starter Pack , which itself commemorates the 20th Anniversary of the Pokémon franchise. The Uniqlo logo is featured in the bottom left corner of the card. It was released in English as one of the XY Black Star Promos , included in the Steam Siege Single Pack Blisters .

Release information This card was included as a Regular card and a Full Art illustration rare card in the 30th Celebration special expansion. The Regular print features artwork by matazo , while the Full Art illustration rare print features artwork by Raita Kazama .

Release information This card was included as a Regular card and a Full Art illustration rare card in the 30th Celebration special expansion. The Regular print features artwork by matazo , while the Full Art illustration rare print features artwork by Raita Kazama .

Release information This card was included as both a Regular card and a Secret card in the Furious Fists expansion, first released in the Japanese Rising Fist expansion. Both prints feature artwork by 5ban Graphics . The Regular print was reprinted in the Japanese Premium Champion Pack . The Regular print was reprinted again, alongside a Full Art card with artwork by the same artist, in the Japanese The Best of XY subset. The Full Art print was subsequently included in the Mega Powers Collection released May 19, 2017, as one of the English Yellow A Alternate cards . A Jumbo version of the card was also included in the collection.

Release information This card was included as both a Regular card and a Secret card in the Phantom Forces expansion, first released in the Japanese Phantom Gate expansion. Both prints feature artwork by 5ban Graphics . A Non Holofoil version of the Regular print was included in the Japanese M Master Deck Build Box Speed Style released August 7, 2015. The Regular print was reprinted again as a Mirror Reverse Holofoil in the Japanese Premium Champion Pack . The Regular print was reprinted once again, alongside a Full Art card with artwork by the same artist, in the Japanese The Best of XY subset. The Full Art print was subsequently included in the Mega Powers Collection released May 19, 2017, as one of the English Yellow A Alternate cards .

Release information This card was included as a Regular card, Full Art ultra rare card, a special illustration rare card, and a gold-etched hyper rare card in the Journey Together expansion, first released in the Japanese Battle Partners expansion. The Regular, Full Art ultra rare, and hyper rare prints feature artwork by takuyoa , while the special illustration rare print features artwork by Megumi Mizutani . In Japan, the Regular print of this card was reprinted in the Japanese MEGA Dream ex subset alongside a special illustration rare print with artwork by Raita Kazama . It is also reprinted in the Start Deck 100 Battle Collection . The N artworks on the Full Art ultra rare and hyper rare prints were illustrated by DOM , who is uncredited on the cards. [ 1 ]

Release information This card was included internationally in the 30th Celebration expansion. In Japan , Taiwan , and Hong Kong , it was released in the 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon product.

Release information This card was included in the Dragons Exalted expansion, first released in the Japanese Dragon Blast expansion. This card was reprinted as one of the BW Black Star Promos released in the Plasma Storm Three Pack Blisters in February 2013 with new artwork by the same artist. In Japan, this print was released as one of the BW-P Promotional cards , given to those who purchased a booster box of either Dragon Blast or Dragon Blade at participating stores.

Release information This card was included in the Next Destinies Blisters , as a Cosmos Holofoil card, and in the Dark Explorers Blisters , as a Non Holofoil card. In Japan, it was given at random, alongside Meowth and Luxio , to those who purchase five booster packs of either Psycho Drive or Hail Blizzard . The Japanese print has the Psycho Drive and Hail Blizzard expansion logos on the bottom of the artwork.

Release information This card was included as both a Regular card and a Full Art Secret card in the Cosmic Eclipse expansion, first released in the Japanese Dream League subset. The Regular print features artwork by Masakazu Fukuda , while the Full Art print features artwork by Mizue .

Release information This card was included internationally in the 30th Celebration expansion. In Japan , Taiwan , and Hong Kong , it was released in the 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon product.

Release information This card was included as a Regular card and a Full Art illustration rare card in the Phantasmal Flames expansion, first released in the Japanese Inferno X expansion. The Regular print features artwork by kawayoo , while the Full Art illustration rare print features artwork by Yoriyuki Ikegami . In Taiwan and Hong Kong , this card is reprinted as a Traditional Chinese M-P Promotional card , and is included as one of the three promo card pairs that can be obtained from the booster pack included in the Inferno X Value Set. The Traditional Chinese M-P Promotional print features artwork by Shiburingaru and the "Inferno X" logo on the bottom right corner of the artwork. The Traditional Chinese M-P Promotional print is released internationally as an MEP Black Star Promotional card and was one of the Prerelease promos for Phantasmal Flames, available in the Phantasmal Flames Build & Battle Box . A print with a gold foil "Staff" stamp was given to those overseeing Prerelease Tournaments .

Release information This card was released as a Cosmos Holofoil SWSH Black Star Promo and was available in the Zacian version of the True Steel Premium Collection from August 14, 2020. In Japan, it was included as a Line Holofoil card in the Zacian + Zamazenta Box , which was released on December 27, 2019.
Release information This card was released as a SWSH Black Star Promo and was available in the Celebrations Deluxe Pin Collection from October 8, 2021.

Release information This card was released as a Cosmos Holofoil SWSH Black Star Promo and was available in the Zamazenta version of the True Steel Premium Collection from August 14, 2020. In Japan, it was included as a Line Holofoil card in the Zacian + Zamazenta Box , which was released on December 27, 2019.

Release information This card was included internationally in the 30th Celebration expansion. In Japan , Taiwan , and Hong Kong , it was released in the 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon product.

Release information This card was included in the Black & White expansion with artwork by Naoki Saito , first released in the Japanese White Collection . It was reprinted as a Cosmos Holofoil BW Black Star Promo with different artwork by the same artist, made available in the Victini Box released on April 25, 2011. In Japan, this print was available to those who purchased a booster box of the Black & White Collections at Gym Challenge. It was later reprinted in the Next Destinies expansion with different artwork by 5ban Graphics as an Ultra-Rare Secret card , first released in the Japanese Psycho Drive expansion. An exclusive Cracked Ice Holofoil version of the Black & White print was included in the Next Destinies Stage 1 Blisters released alongside the expansion. The Black & White print was later reprinted as part of the Japanese Master Deck Build Box EX , released on September 14, 2012. An exclusive Non Holofoil version of the Black & White print was included in the Battle Arena Decks: Mewtwo vs. Darkrai . The Black & White print was reprinted again as a Non Holofoil in the Japanese Extra Regulation Box released on October 4, 2019.

Release information This card was released as a BW Black Star Promotional card released in the Zoroark-Illusions Collection box in October 2011. The box contains a normal size holographic, as well as a lenticular oversized version. In Japan, this card was available at the Next Generation World Hobby Fair in January 2011.

Release information This card was included in the Black & White expansion with artwork by Naoki Saito , first released in the Japanese White Collection . It was reprinted as a Cosmos Holofoil BW Black Star Promo with different artwork by the same artist, made available in the Victini Box released on April 25, 2011. In Japan, this print was available to those who purchased a booster box of the Black & White Collections at Gym Challenge. It was later reprinted in the Next Destinies expansion with different artwork by 5ban Graphics as an Ultra-Rare Secret card , first released in the Japanese Psycho Drive expansion. An exclusive Cracked Ice Holofoil version of the Black & White print was included in the Next Destinies Stage 1 Blisters released alongside the expansion. The Black & White print was later reprinted as part of the Japanese Master Deck Build Box EX , released on September 14, 2012. An exclusive Non Holofoil version of the Black & White print was included in the Battle Arena Decks: Mewtwo vs. Darkrai . The Black & White print was reprinted again as a Non Holofoil in the Japanese Extra Regulation Box released on October 4, 2019.

Release information This card was included internationally in the 30th Celebration expansion. In Japan , Taiwan , and Hong Kong , it was released in the 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon product.

Release information This card was released as one of the BW Black Star Promos . It was included as a Holofoil card in the Emerging Powers Three Pack Blisters . In Japan, this card was released as a promotional card during a shirt campaign by clothing company Uniqlo starting March 14, 2011.
